name: Quick Chat
afterHooks: cd $RELEASE_PATH && docker compose -p chat-app -f compose.prod.yaml up -d --remove-orphans --build && echo 'Waiting for MySQL to get an IP...' && sleep 10 && DB_IP=$(docker inspect -f '{{range .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{.IPAddress}}{{end}}' chat-app-prod-mysql) && echo "Detected MySQL IP: $DB_IP" && sed -i "s/DB_HOST=.*/DB_HOST=$DB_IP/g" .env && docker exec chat-app-prod-php php artisan config:clear && docker exec chat-app-prod-php php artisan migrate --force
